changelog: - **New relations start on the tenant's own first on-path stage, not `APPLICATION_100`** (#1634). Every create path let the schema default apply, so an organisation that customised its pipeline got relations parked on a key absent from its own `PipelineStage` rows: no board column to render in, no funnel row to count in, and no stage select to move out of — the mentee was invisible from the moment they were assigned. A pure `startStageKey(stages)` in `lib/pipeline.ts` (first of `onPathKeys`, so an off-path "withdrew" stage ordered first can never be a start) and its DB-backed wrapper `resolveStartStage(orgId)` in `lib/pipelineStages.ts` are now called by all four application creation sites — the admin assignment `POST /api/mentorship`, the mentor's own add-a-mentee form, the mentorship-request approval in `lib/mentorshipDecision.ts` and the invitation auto-link in `POST /api/register` — while the seeders and the legacy CSV importer keep writing their own intended stage verbatim. An org with no custom stages resolves to the canonical set and still starts on `APPLICATION_100`, so single-tenant behaviour is byte-identical; the schema `@default` stays as the last-resort floor for a row created outside the application. `prisma/backfill-relation-start-stage.mjs` (wired into `deploy-prod.sh`) repairs the relations already stranded, writing a `StatusChange` per move so the correction is auditable rather than silent, and converging to a no-op on the next deploy.

en: If your organisation renamed or replaced the pipeline stages, a newly assigned mentee now appears in your first stage instead of a stage your board does not have.
Mentees already stranded on a stage outside your pipeline are moved to your first stage, and the move is recorded in their status history.
tr: Kuruluşunuz hat aşamalarını yeniden adlandırdıysa veya değiştirdiyse, yeni eşleştirilen bir danışan artık panonuzda olmayan bir aşamada değil, kendi ilk aşamanızda görünüyor.
Hattınızda bulunmayan bir aşamada takılı kalmış danışanlar ilk aşamanıza taşınır ve bu taşıma durum geçmişlerine kaydedilir.
de: Wenn Ihre Organisation die Pipeline-Stufen umbenannt oder ersetzt hat, erscheint ein neu zugewiesener Mentee jetzt in Ihrer ersten Stufe statt in einer Stufe, die es auf Ihrem Board gar nicht gibt.
Mentees, die bereits auf einer Stufe außerhalb Ihrer Pipeline feststeckten, werden in Ihre erste Stufe verschoben — die Verschiebung wird in ihrem Statusverlauf festgehalten.
